content.title: Texas Instruments Stock Slips. It Caught a Rare Downgrade From Goldman Sachs.
content.summary: Texas Instruments  is the world’s largest player in analog semiconductors, but its stock may get left behind even as the industry rallies, analysts at Goldman Sachs said.  The investment bank issued a rare double downgrade for  Texas Instruments  shares Monday, dropping its rating for the stock all the way to Sell from Buy in a research note.  Texas Instruments shares slipped 0.5% to $178.50 on Monday.
